Hi Ava —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our conversation I want to lock in a 45-60m demo (SE-driven) and then a separate 60m contract redline session (legal + procurement + Redwood AE/Legal). To keep things moving on your side, can you confirm who from procurement and security needs to join for the redline readout?

Proposed demo windows (PT):
 - Wed 11/11: 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
 - Thu 11/12: 09:00–10:00 or 16:00–17:00

For redlines I suggest Fri 11/13 11:00–12:00 PT (60m) so the legal/procurement team has the runbook and our SE can walk any integration concerns first-hand. If that doesn't work for your group, happy to split into two shorter sessions.

I've attached the RFP and a short mutual action plan that outlines proposed agenda and who we expect to attend.

Attachments: GreenGrid_RFP.pdf

Quick asks:
 - Confirm demo window that works for your engineers (and timezone)
 - Provide procurement/security contact(s) for redline invite
 - Any specific contract clauses you want called out ahead of the session (data residency, retention, indemnity)

Thanks — will coordinate calendar invites as soon as we have a time.

Cheers,
